dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Ms. Wilson, can I ask you a few questions? There are some things here I still don't understand.
dialogue.reading: ˈmɪz ˈwɪlsən, kən aɪ ˈæsk juː ə ˈfjuː ˈkwɛstʃənz? ðɛr ər sʌm ˈθɪŋz ˈhɪr aɪ ˈstɪl ˈdoʊnt ˌʌndərˈstænd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Of course, Nam. What's the problem?
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs, ˈnɑːm. ˈwʌts ðə ˈprɑːbləm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yesterday I bought a coffee. The price was three dollars, but I paid more.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛstərdeɪ aɪ ˈbɔːt ə ˈkɔːfi. ðə ˈpraɪs wʌz ˈθriː ˈdɑːlərz, bʌt aɪ ˈpeɪd ˈmɔːr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's sales tax. In Canada, they add it when you pay. It isn't in the price you see.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈseɪlz ˌtæks. ɪn ˈkænədə, ðeɪ ˈæd ɪt wɛn juː ˈpeɪ. ɪt ˈɪzənt ɪn ðə ˈpraɪs juː ˈsiː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I see. And at restaurants? My friend said you have to tip.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈsiː. ənd ət ˈrɛstərɑːnts? maɪ ˈfrɛnd ˈsɛd juː ˈhæf tə ˈtɪp.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes. People usually tip about fifteen percent.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ˈpiːpəl ˈjuːʒuəli ˈtɪp əˈbaʊt ˌfɪfˈtiːn pərˈsɛnt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. What about healthcare? What if I get sick?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˈhɛlθkɛr? ˈwʌt ɪf aɪ ˈɡɛt ˈsɪk?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: You have health insurance through the university. You just show your card when you see a doctor.
dialogue.reading: juː ˈhæv ˈhɛlθ ɪnˈʃʊrəns θruː ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti. juː dʒʌst ˈʃoʊ jʊr ˈkɑːrd wɛn juː ˈsiː ə ˈdɑːktər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's good. And can I work here part-time? Do I need a work permit?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈɡʊd. ənd kən aɪ ˈwɜːrk ˈhɪr ˈpɑːrt ˈtaɪm? duː aɪ ˈniːd ə ˈwɜːrk ˈpɜːrmɪt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, you'd need a permit for that, and there's a lot of paperwork. Let's talk about it next week.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, juːd ˈniːd ə ˈpɜːrmɪt fər ðæt, ənd ðɛrz ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈpeɪpərwɜːrk. ˈlɛts ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt ɪt ˈnɛkst ˈwiːk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: So much paperwork! In Thailand, we complain about it, too.
dialogue.reading: soʊ ˈmʌtʃ ˈpeɪpərwɜːrk! ɪn ˈtaɪlænd, wiː kəmˈpleɪn əˈbaʊt ɪt, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Ha! People complain about it everywhere.
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! ˈpiːpəl kəmˈpleɪn əˈbaʊt ɪt ˈɛvriwɛr.
